instruction: Adversarial review of WP-SCP-022 slice 020F (Renovate shared preset + SCP self consumes) at correctness lens. The slice's surface is three config files: renovate/default.json (shared preset), renovate.json (SCP-self consumer), and .github/dependabot.yml (extended to add groups + scope). VERIFY each artefact: (1) renovate/default.json — schema validity (matches https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json), the customManager regex correctly extracts both `currentDigest` (40-char hex SHA) AND `currentValue` (semver tag from the `# tag: ...` comment) from the canonical adopter wrapper marker. The marker pattern is documented at WP-SCP-020 020H part 3 (will land in slice 020H part 3) and currently appears in `.github/workflows/policy-check-wrapper.yml`. The regex must match on the multi-line block: `# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-` (line) ... `uses: jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-/<workflow>@<SHA>  # tag: <semver>` (line). The `[\s\S]*?` between the two key lines should be lazy-matching whitespace. Verify the match groups are correctly captured + named for Renovate's templating. (2) renovate/default.json packageRules — `matchPackageNames` correctly targets `jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-`. `groupName: scp-federation-primitive` groups rc + GA bumps. `automerge: false` is correct (per single-operator review-shape). (3) renovate.json — the consumer extends the preset via the GitHub-shorthand `github>jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-//renovate/default`. Note the double-slash before `renovate/default` is Renovate's preset-path syntax (NOT typo) — the path component is literal subpath inside the repo. (4) .github/dependabot.yml — schema validity (Dependabot v2 grammar). The new `groups:` clause uses `gh-actions-minor-patch` correctly with `update-types: [minor, patch]`. Major-version bumps escape grouping (default Dependabot semver behaviour). (5) Run a fresh test against the actual `policy-check-wrapper.yml` on main to confirm the regex would match it: the marker line is `# renovate: datasource=github-tags depName=jrnb2024/standards-control-plane-`, then a few lines of comments, then the `uses:` line with `@<SHA>  # tag: post-v1.0.0 + warn-msg fix (020D1.1)` — verify the match. (6) `# tag:` comment-value parsing: in the actual wrapper the tag value is `post-v1.0.0 + warn-msg fix (020D1.1)` which is NOT a semver. The regex requires `currentValue` to start with `v?[0-9]`. Will Renovate fall over on the current-state tag value? Check whether this is a real bug or an acceptable transition state (the @SHA pin is what matters operationally; the tag-comment is documentation). (7) `automerge: false` on packageRules: confirmed correct under SCP self's required-PR-reviews shape — the admin merges manually after CI green. Any syntactic, schema, or regex error is a finding. Run actual schema validation if possible. Per WP-SCP-022 §4.3 fixpoint criteria. Return SonnetReviewResult JSON.
